scientific_question: Can a forecaster trained around physical-event-balanced genuine new SEP onset improve causal 24-hour warning under the already-frozen NEW-crossing benchmark?

outer_role_policy.fit: architecture selection and final parameter fitting only
outer_role_policy.score: one-shot development evaluation after architecture freeze
outer_role_policy.monitor: secondary development evaluation; already historically exposed

inner_selection.method: expanding chronological physical-unit cross-fit inside outer fit role

event_balanced_weighting.unit_definition: positive physical onset episode or contiguous negative quiet block
event_balanced_weighting.row_weight_within_unit: unit weight divided equally across rows

uncertainty.bootstrap_unit: physical event or contiguous quiet block

published_architecture_comparison.description: released architecture / fixed recipe under IRIS chronology; not exact paper random-IID reproduction
published_architecture_comparison.claim_if_better: same-cohort development superiority only; never universal SOTA

claim_boundary: No operational-readiness claim from historical development data.
No universal state-of-the-art claim from unmatched published headline metrics.
A successful Phase II result remains development evidence until independently confirmed prospectively.
